appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Incidence of Condition A in US States'.

A color scale bar is positioned on the right side of the map, labeled 'Low' at the bottom (dark red, value 0) and 'High' at the top (light yellow, value 100).
State abbreviations are centered within each state's boundary.
The color gradient is continuous, with no discrete color breaks or legend categories.
States are shaded according to their incidence level, with darker red indicating higher incidence and lighter yellow indicating lower incidence.
The color scale bar includes labeled tick marks at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100.
The color scale bar has a gradient from dark red (low) to light yellow (high), with intermediate shades of orange.
